# ZAC Forge

> A senior-led, AI-native technology studio. ZAC advises on where technology creates leverage,
> builds the systems that follow, and partners as ongoing senior capability, without agency
> overhead.

ZAC pairs senior technology judgment with AI-native execution. The team is small and senior by
design: one point of contact, with development, design, and strategy behind it, plus trusted
specialists brought in when a project calls for more depth.

## Services

- Advise: technology strategy, AI opportunity assessment, product and platform direction,
  workflow analysis, architecture and technical planning.
- Build: custom software, web applications, high-performance websites, internal tools, workflow
  automation, AI integrations and agents, prototypes and MVPs.
- Partner: fractional technology leadership, ongoing product development, technical problem
  solving, specialist team assembly, existing platform improvement.
